items.html:
Graham Hume is a left-hand batsman and right-arm medium pacer who compares his style to South African fast bowler Charl Langeveldt but whose hero is AB de Villiers. He was named in South Africa's squad for the Under-19 World Cup in New Zealand in January 2010 and he was his team's leading wicket-taker with 13 wickets.
Cricinfo staff January 2010
